title: Number Theory
description: Primes, modular forms and the Riemann zeta function - the hardest problems in mathematics are about whole numbers.

puzzle.goal: Every whole number factors into primes in exactly one way. Use that to rewrite the series of 1/nˢ over all positive integers as a product, one factor for each prime p_k, where each factor is the geometric series of all powers of that prime.
puzzle.name: Euler product formula for the zeta function
puzzle.ask: The pole of this function at s = 1, and the absence of zeros on the line Re s = 1, give the prime count π(x) ≈ x / ln x. Estimate the number of primes below x = @{x}.
puzzle.method: Multiply out the product: choosing one power from each prime's series gives each integer's factorisation exactly once.
